Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick availability for a short walkthrough

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up for the trial. Quick note from our side: we usually do a short 15-minute walkthrough to help teams validate latency/cost expectations and get a test prompt running. No sales pitch — just a technical pairing session so your engineers can evaluate the runtime and integration surface.

A few options:
- Book a 15-minute slot directly: https://cal.redwood.ai/jordan/15min
- If you prefer, reply with 2x windows that work for your team and I’ll lock something in.

If you’d like an engineer on the call, reply and I’ll loop in one of our backend engineers. I’ve attached a tiny runbook with what we typically cover.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
